title: Continuous-weight covariation of two completed Itô rows
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: Continuous-weight covariation of two completed Itô rows. Exact assumptions and formula below.
target_statement: Let X and Y be two real Itô rows driven by the same standard vector Brownian motion relative to the given filtration and measure. For an almost surely continuous real weight with measurable time slices, the left-endpoint weighted products of dyadic increments converge in measure to the time integral of the weight times the inner product of the diffusion coefficients.
